item.title: Norfolk prosecutor Ramin Fatehi offers perspective on Iran strikes
item.description: Norfolk Commonwealth's Attorney Ramin Fatehi is among the Iranian Americans closely watching as the United States and Israel carry out strikes against Iran.

item.title: Hampton man says father stranded in Bahrain after airstrikes
item.description: A Hampton Roads family says a local father is unable to leave Bahrain after airstrikes there led to flight cancellations and tightened travel restrictions.

item.title: Virginia trooper shoots, kills man after deadly I-495 stabbings; woman killed
item.description: A Virginia State Police trooper shot and killed a man Sunday after authorities say he approached the trooper with a knife following a crash and multiple stabbings on Interstate 495 in Fairfax.
